3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:687d57b8-98eb.description: Launch and Grow Your Own ABA Practice — with Zero Upfront Costs Join 3Y Health and earn $100,000 - $320,000/year while making your own schedule. Tired of rigid clinical environments and professional burnout? Looking to build a practice and don’t know where to start? At 3Y Health, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where you can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/autism-therapy-aba What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you, your RBTs, and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re in-network with 100+ payers at high market rates, giving you broad access to patients. - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own ABA company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you and your RBTs if you’d like. Your Role: - Own and operate your practice – Set your hours, select clients, and define how you deliver care. - Hire and lead your RBTs – Build a team that aligns with your vision. - Deliver exceptional ABA therapy – You’re the expert. We give you the platform to thrive. Why BCBAs Love 3Y Health: - 100% autonomy with zero admin headaches - Real earning potential with no financial risk - Flexible work-from-anywhere model - Make a bigger impact without burning out

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:2d102454-.description: Principal Web Data Specialist About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate, leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career, from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. We need a data person who has some SEO knowledge, not the other way around. Own the integrity of the data pipeline and architecture that powers SEO, AEO and content strategy across Gen's brands. Build, maintain and deliver the reporting and dashboards that turn that data into decisions. Lead cross-org analytics projects and work with a distributed team across the US, Europe and UK to keep priorities aligned and communicate the team's value. About the Team: We are a team of SEO/AEO analysts and content strategists, working closely with content, engineering and central data teams. We build our own tooling, including a custom Google Cloud data platform that powers SEO/AEO reporting & analytics as well as AI-search visibility tracking across the portfolio. Key Responsibilities: - Own and evolve the team's data warehousing and reporting infrastructure: developing and maintaining SQL queries, cross-platform data pipelines, and cloud functions/API connections that power SEO and AEO performance tracking across the brand portfolio. BigQuery/GCP and Power BI are must-haves; Snowflake is a nice-to-have. - Lead analytics platform migration projects from a stakeholder perspective, representing the Organic Growth team's requirements with the central data organization, ensuring data quality and continuity throughout transitions, and coordinating pipeline setup to prevent any gap in reporting coverage. - Work closely with AEO and content strategists to build and maintain performance dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI and Periscope; translate complex datasets into clear, decision-ready views for SEO/AEO leads, content teams and leadership. - Drive SEO/AEO/content analytics projects end to end, from architecture to reporting, visualizations and insights. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a42f6575-b997-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Gerente de Engenharia - Head of Engineering based in Brazil. This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity focused on people, processes, technology, and product quality. You will oversee the development lifecycle, helping engineering teams translate customer and user needs into impactful solutions. The role combines technical leadership with people management, prioritization, planning, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including participation in technical discussions with customers. Your leadership will directly contribute to improving product quality, delivery effectiveness, and the overall engineering experience. The environment is remote, collaborative, purpose-driven, and comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage challenges. This role is ideal for an experienced engineering leader who wants to combine technology, team development, and meaningful social impact. Lead and manage engineering teams, overseeing people, processes, workflows, and the overall software development lifecycle. Plan short- and long-term engineering demands, activities, priorities, resources, and delivery timelines. Review development work and code to help maintain and continuously improve technical quality. Understand customer and user needs across different scenarios and translate them into appropriate engineering priorities. Define priorities, estimate effort, establish deadlines, and ensure effective execution across initiatives. Maintain active, clear, and didactic communication with engineering teams and other departments. Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and provide ongoing guidance, feedback, and support to team members. Participate in technical meetings with internal and external customers, helping align expectations and solutions. Drive initiatives that improve product quality, engineering processes, and delivery outcomes. Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, accountability, and continuous development within the engineering organization. Requirements: Professional experience in software development and engineering leadership or management. Strong understanding of software development practices, Git/GitHub, and cloud infrastructure. Demonstrated experience managing and developing engineering teams and supporting individual growth. Advanced English proficiency, with strong written and spoken communication skills. Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management abilities. Collaborative mindset with a genuine interest in diversity, inclusion, and accessibility. Curiosity, initiative, and a structured, action-oriented approach to solving problems. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving, and early-stage environments. Strong focus on impact and outcomes rather than simply measuring output. Ability to balance technical considerations, business priorities, customer needs, and team development. Experience with project management and/or product management is considered a plus. Comfortable taking ownership, making decisions, and driving initiatives from conception through execution. Benefits: CLT employment contract , providing statutory employment rights and security from day one. Caju benefits card of R$1,160 per month , with flexible use for meals, food, home office, culture, and mobility. 100% remote work , with the freedom to work from anywhere in Brazil. SulAmérica health insurance . SulAmérica dental insurance . SulAmérica life insurance . Online medical consultations through Conexa Saúde . Wellhub membership to support physical and overall well-being. Extended year-end holiday break . Birthday day off . Extended parental leave . Continuous professional development through LinkedIn Learning and an annual training/course allowance. Partnerships with universities offering discounts and additional learning opportunities.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c5d0ac86-4808-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vendor Security & Standards Manager based in Spain. This is a senior global security role focused on ensuring external supply chain partners consistently meet rigorous security standards. You will own vendor security requirements across carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, and last-mile providers. The role combines standards ownership, physical compliance inspections, corrective action management, and vendor performance oversight. You will operate across multiple international regions, identifying security gaps and driving measurable improvements across a complex vendor network. Success requires a firm, independent approach and the ability to hold vendors accountable while building effective working relationships. The position offers significant exposure to global supply chain security, critical infrastructure, and rapidly evolving technology environments. Extensive international travel will be an important part of the role, with occasional availability required for urgent compliance matters. Own and continuously improve the global vendor security standards framework, ensuring requirements remain comprehensive, current, enforceable, and aligned with relevant policies and industry best practices. Establish and enforce clear security compliance expectations for carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, last-mile providers, and other external supply chain partners. Ensure vendors formally accept applicable security requirements before beginning operational activities and work with legal and procurement teams to embed these obligations into contracts and service agreements. Conduct scheduled and unannounced physical inspections at vendor facilities, transit locations, and operational sites across international regions. Verify controls such as access management, personnel screening, CCTV, handling procedures, tamper-evident measures, and chain-of-custody processes against established standards, including TAPA FSR and TAPA TSR where applicable. Produce detailed inspection reports, document compliance gaps, identify systemic risks, and provide practical recommendations for remediation. Issue corrective action requirements to non-compliant vendors, establish binding remediation timelines, and track outstanding actions through to verified resolution. Conduct follow-up inspections to confirm that corrective measures have been implemented effectively and sustainably. Maintain an accurate global vendor compliance register covering inspection history, corrective actions, risk exposure, and current compliance status. Escalate persistent or serious non-compliance and recommend appropriate measures, including sanctions, suspension, or vendor replacement when necessary. Act as the primary security compliance contact for external vendors, communicating expectations clearly and assertively to security and operational leadership. Conduct structured vendor security reviews, support new-vendor assessments, and define security requirements that must be met before operational activation. Prepare global compliance reports for leadership, identify recurring patterns across vendors or regions, and recommend improvements to standards, policies, procedures, and enforcement mechanisms. Work closely with regional security teams across the USA, EU, Taiwan, APAC, Israel, and future operating regions to maintain consistent security expectations and enforcement. Requirements Significant professional experience in supply chain security compliance, vendor auditing, physical security, or security standards enforcement. Proven experience conducting physical security inspections and compliance assessments across complex, multi-vendor or international environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fe1df60d-5a03-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills. southparkcommons-meesho:lever:e640ec64-9.description: About the Team You will join the Fulfilment and Experience (F&E) team at Meesho. Our mission is to help businesses and their employees explore, set, and achieve their financial goals. We are interested in speaking with individuals based in Edinburgh for this position! The main purpose of this role is research and write advice reports, support training and development of the team, and to take an active role in maintaining paraplanning tools and reference material. We offer a competitive flexible hybrid working pattern for this Paraplanning role. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to step up to the next level as a Paraplanner.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:5801af7b-b45.description: About the Role We're looking for an Automation Specialist to join our Movie and TV Metadata team — a unique, blended role for someone who wants to combine hands-on content work with the chance to build real AI and automation solutions. You'll start by working as a fully contributing project specialist, gaining first-hand knowledge of our workflows, and then progressively apply your technical skills to streamline and automate them. This is an exciting opportunity for those with a passion for movies, TV shows, and the film industry, who are also keen to apply their automation and AI skillsets to help streamline and improve operations — working closely with Project Managers and program leadership every step of the way. Project Details Job Title: Automation Specialist-1 Working Hours: 10:00-18:30 CDT (40 hours/ week)* Tuesday to Saturday or Sunday to Thursday shift Duration: Contract -indefinite . Salary/Compensation: 480,000 MXN/ yearly Location: Mexico (Remote)
responsibilities: Get hands-on with the Movie & TV Metadata project
Perform quality assurance on movie and TV metadata by accurately following testing instructions and test cases.
Ensure content review and curation adhere to project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides, and client-preferred checklists and glossaries.
Complete assigned tasks to a high standard and on time, including repetitive work.
Prioritise tasks and issues quickly and effectively, especially as requirements shift.
Find opportunities to improve how we work
Analyse workflow data and operational performance to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities.
Document opportunities, build a prioritised backlog, and translate your findings into clear, actionable recommendations for Project Managers and leadership.
Track the impact of the solutions you build and iterate based on feedback and performance data.
Design and build automation & AI tools
Design, develop, and deploy automation and AI-assisted tools using approved platforms, under the guidance of your Project Manager.
Use scripting or programming skills (Python, JavaScript, or equivalent) to build robust, maintainable solutions starting with proofs of concept and building toward a steady cadence of delivery.
Create clear documentation and share knowledge with the wider team to support adoption of what you build. Keep an eye on emerging AI and automation tooling and bring good ideas back to the team.
qualifications: Comfortable maintaining focus in a stationary role with extended computer use.
Willingness to work in a high-volume, evolving environment where priorities may shift.
This role may involve exposure to content that could be considered sensitive (e.g. content related to health,adult themes, violence, or other mature topics) as part of standard project workflows.
